scenes.narration: Both statements are true. They describe two very different kinds of knowing.

spec.title: Two kinds of knowing
spec.body: Mapped: measured from a distance, mostly by sonar. Seen: observed directly, by camera or eye.

scenes.narration: So how do we actually know what is down there? And what is the difference between having a map of a place and having truly looked at it?
